transactions.desc: Van Eyk was optioned to Triple-A Buffalo after Sunday's 7-0 win over the Mariners.
Ferguson was released by the Cardinals on Sunday, Derrick Goold of the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reports.
Anderson (shoulder) was reinstated from the 15-day injured list and designated for assignment by the Angels on Saturday.
Rivero (hand) was reinstated from the 60-day injured list and optioned to Triple-A Salt Lake on Saturday.
The Angels demoted Martin to Triple-A Salt Lake on Sunday.
The Angels called up Weiman from Triple-A Salt Lake on Sunday.
The Angels promoted Farris from Triple-A Salt Lake on Sunday.
The Mariners recalled Davila from Triple-A Tacoma on Sunday.
San Diego placed Sheets on the 10-day injured list Sunday with a left foot sprain.
San Diego recalled Song from Triple-A El Paso on Sunday.
The Padres activated Taylor (oblique) from the 10-day injured list Sunday.
The Twins recalled Gonzalez from Triple-A St. Paul on Sunday.
The Yankees optioned De Los Santos to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Sunday.
The Yankees promoted Gil from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Sunday.
The Cardinals recalled Prieto from Triple-A Memphis on Sunday.
The Red Sox activated Story (abdomen) from the 60-day injured list Sunday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports. He is starting at shortstop and batting eighth against the Yankees.
The Red Sox optioned Seigler to Triple-A Worcester on Sunday, per Jen McCaffrey of The Athletic.
The Red Sox reinstated Anthony (finger) from the 60-day injured list Sunday, Tim Healey of The Boston Globe reports. He is batting leadoff as the designated hitter against the Yankees.
Boston optioned Gasper to Triple-A Worcester on Sunday, per Jen McCaffrey of The Athletic.
Beck was returned to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre following the second game of the Yankees' doubleheader against the Red Sox on Saturday.
The Giants optioned Lonsway to Triple-A Sacramento following Game 1 of Saturday's doubleheader against the Diamondbacks.
The Giants selected Marte's contract from Double-A Richmond ahead of his scheduled start against the Diamondbacks on Saturday.
The Mets placed Robert on outright waivers Saturday, Anthony DiComo of MLB.com reports.
The Yankees designated Topa for assignment Saturday.
The Yankees reinstated Fried (elbow) from the 15-day injured list ahead of his start in Game 2 of Saturday's doubleheader against Boston.
The Diamondbacks added Bratt to the active roster to serve as the 27th man for Saturday's doubleheader against the Giants. He will start Game 2.
The Diamondbacks selected Law's contract from Triple-A Reno on Saturday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Drake to Triple-A Reno on Saturday.
The Giants selected Lonsway's contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Saturday.
The Giants optioned Bivens to Triple-A Sacramento on Saturday.
